page_title: RBL 2-2 BAY | RB Leipzig v Bayern Munich 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Janis Blaswich didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
90+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich), but Janis Blaswich is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
87' A substitution has been made. Jamal Musiala goes off and Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) comes on.
87' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Benjamin Henrichs is replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
86' Here comes a substitution. Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig) is brought on as a substitute for Lois Openda.
84' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) and Min-Jae Kim perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
81' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
80' A short through ball almost allows Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
78' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a long cross over to Harry Kane, but Janis Blaswich comes forward to gather the ball. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
76' David Raum (RB Leipzig) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
75' A dangerous looking corner kick from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is cleared to safety by the defence.
72' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) replaces Emil Forsberg.
72' Yussuf Poulsen comes off the pitch to be replaced by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
72' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) picked up a yellow card from referee.

70' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Jamal Musiala slips the ball through to Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
70' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
69' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) plays a terrific long ball forward to Yussuf Poulsen, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down. Corner kick. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity.

67' What a wasted opportunity by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Janis Blaswich makes a decent save to thwart him. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
64' Marco Rose is forced to make a change. Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nicolas Seiwald.
64' That's a clear yellow card. Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) goes into the book.
63' Marco Fritz blows his whistle as Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. RB Leipzig are awarded the free kick.
61' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a chip pass into the box, but Janis Blaswich is quickest to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will take a throw-in.
60' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig. So close! Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Janis Blaswich to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
56' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
55' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bayern Munich!
54' There's a break in play and referee Marco Fritz must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayern Munich using VAR. This could be interesting!
54' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
53' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
53' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) picks out Lois Openda with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
51' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
50' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
49' Janis Blaswich (RB Leipzig) sends an accurate short pass. Castello Lukeba controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
47' Now RB Leipzig have a corner. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
46' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Leon Goretzka will be replaced by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich).
46' It is time for a substitution. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) is on for Kingsley Coman.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Fritz starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Sven Ulreich (Bayern Munich) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
44' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) couldn't beat the offside trap and the flag goes up. The assistant referee quickly made a difficult call as it was a really tight offside.
43' David Raum (RB Leipzig) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
40' Emil Forsberg is able to continue with the attacking effort as he latches on to a beautiful defence-splitting lofted pass, which was supplied by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig).
38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
37' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. RB Leipzig have a free kick.
36' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
33' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
31' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
30' One of the RB Leipzig players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick is awarded to Bayern Munich.
30' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) and Leroy Sane perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
26' 2 - 0 Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) meets a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires home. His effort goes into the middle of the goal and hits the net.
26' David Raum (RB Leipzig) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

24' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Fritz blows for a foul. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
23' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) and Jamal Musiala combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
19' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a throw-in.
16' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) and Konrad Laimer matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
14' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.

12' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
11' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

10' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
9' It's a throw-in for RB Leipzig.
8' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sven Ulreich intercepts the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
7' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
5' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and David Raum darts into free space to control the ball.

3' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Janis Blaswich inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
1' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) finds Joshua Kimmich with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
